reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Five em dashes. Three became commas around genuinely appositive material, one became a period so the four short-term failures could land as a list before the diagnosis, and one paired dash was rebuilt so the closing question could run in one breath.

The basic condition of being human in time, the definition of the future ancestor with the unborn who have no vote, the widened circle, the four demonstrations, and we are those strangers, the four short-term failures, the representation of future generations, and the closing question.

openQuestions: The chapter is 581 baseline words and lost 61 percent of them with zero verbatim survival, which makes it one of the two most completely rewritten sections in the volume. Nothing in it touches the ledger, so the loss was purely literary and the restoration reopens nothing.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section is the cleanest control in the volume: no debt item reaches it, so every difference between baseline and shipped text is attributable to the pass's judgment alone. Sixty-one percent of the words and all four of the chapter's demonstrations went, and the propositions that remain are all true. That is what compression without a ledger conflict looks like when it goes wrong.
